facts.fact: The Arabic text of Law No. 43-20 on trust services for electronic transactions sets simple, advanced and qualified electronic signatures, denies simple and advanced signatures rejection in court for being electronic, and provides for approved trust service providers; the text carries no enactment date, so the published date 2020-12-31 (a proxy, the promulgating dahir's date) is used.
